top_level_scalar_fields.objective_change: base_link and the distal system are now inside the objective, unlike A3.2c
top_level_scalar_fields.headline: the complete stowed B601 system (base_link + links1-6 + gripper_link + 2 fingers) does not fit the nominal 12U envelope under any of the 16 optimised cases; the minimax protrusion is +7.99 mm/face at 0 deg hard-limit margin and +8.67 mm/face at 2 deg, both above the 6.5 mm CDS allowance
top_level_scalar_fields.subset_finding: neither the base nor the gripper breaks the fit on its own. BASE+LINKS16 fits at 0 deg (-1.80) and misses at 2 deg (+2.81). LINKS16+GRIPPER fits at both (-3.00 / -2.06). Only the combination fails (+7.99 / +8.67). They compete for the same volume around the folded root.
top_level_scalar_fields.corridor_cost: the links1-6 corridor thickness rises from 80.3 mm (A3.2c, links1-6 only) to 90.8-113.9 mm once base and gripper are in the objective
